{{Otheruses|Adriana|more=ice (disambiguation)|more2=ring (disambiguation)}}
'''Adriana's ice rings''' were a system of rings that [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Adriana]]. The rings consisted of [[Water/Legends|ice]] which was [[Mining/Legends|mined]] and transported to the nearby [[Desert/Legends|desert]] world of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], where it was sold to the local inhabitants as their main source of water.
